WITH fetched AS (
                SELECT
                    id,
                    cmd,
                    continue_on_error
                FROM command_queue
                WHERE device_id = $1
                  AND fetched = false
                  AND canceled = false
                  AND available_at <= now()
                  -- smith-rescue takes Restarts once it has polled /smith/restart.
                  AND NOT (
                      cmd::jsonb = '"Restart"'::jsonb
                      AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM device WHERE id = $1 AND has_restart_channel
                      )
                  )
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT $2
                FOR UPDATE
            ),
            marked AS (
                UPDATE command_queue
                SET fetched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, fetched = true
                WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM fetched)
                RETURNING id, cmd, continue_on_error
            )
            SELECT
                id AS "id!",
                cmd AS "cmd!",
                continue_on_error AS "continue_on_error!"
            FROM marked
            ORDER BY id
